$comment: Claims ledger (charter rule 7). Every machine-checkable claim in README.md appears here with the exact command that verifies it. scripts/check-claims.sh runs each check offline; exit 0 = claim holds. Never add a claim whose check needs a live indexer to this file — live checks belong in the nightly tier.

check.cmd: test -s app/page.tsx && test -s app/simulate/page.tsx && test -s app/status/page.tsx

production code imports no fixtures or recorded responses
the dashboard holds no wallet integration and no secrets
